title: terpsichore reclinata
intro: Terpsichore reclinata, commonly known as the Flexible Lady Fern or Rattlesnake Fern, is a species of fern in the family Polypodiaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including the ability to reduce inflammation, improve respiratory issues, and act as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Terpsichore reclinata include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help to soothe skin irritations and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
